<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex28022024-09-2015-39-312" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Closing verses"/>
         <lg><l>thub pa'i gsung dang de'i dgongs <lb edRef="inst:4664" n="39b6"/> 'grel rnams ||</l> 
            <l>yang <note type="editorial">(ID:6858) reads "spang"</note> du byas <app><lem>ste</lem><rdg wit="inst:4664">ste</rdg><rdg wit="inst:6858">te</rdg></app> legs par bshad mod na'ang ¦</l> 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bdag</rs> blo byis pa'i dbang gyur 'gal 'khrul rnams ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">daM pa rnaMs</rs> kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol ||</l> 
           <l> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6857">bdag</rs> gi phan sems rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i ||</l> 
            <l>sgrung <choice><corr>'grel</corr><sic>'brel</sic></choice><note type="editorial">(ID:6858) reads "'grel"</note> ngo mtshar <abbr>rin chen</abbr> phreng ba 'di ||</l> 
            <l>skye rgu'i blo yi dbul ba brtan <note type="editorial">(ID:6858) corrects the reading to "gtan"</note> bcoM nas ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kun mkhyen rgyal <lb edRef="inst:4664" n="39b7"/> ba</rs>'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur 1 |</l>
           <l> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6857">bdag</rs> kyang <rs type="deity">'jam pa'i dbyangs</rs> kyis rjes bzung ste ||</l> 
            <l>thos bsaM sgom pa'i dpal 'byor gyis phyug cing ||</l> 
            <l><abbr>'bras bu</abbr> sku 4'i dngos grub myur thob nas ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="deity">kun tu bzang po</rs>'i dpal la spyod par shog ||</l> </lg></seg></TEI>
source: 1_028_02_ dBang phyug rin chen _ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i sgrung 'grel.xml
